entities.name: Sarya Haasendel
entities.description: A dwarven captain in Sarpadia who took command after General Danhelm was slain and led survivors into an abandoned mine.

entities.name: General Danhelm
entities.description: Dwarven leader slain at Gurn Keep.

entities.name: Gurn Keep
entities.description: Keep attacked by the orc-goblin alliance.

entities.name: Kolevi of Havenwood
entities.description: Recipient of Sarya's plea, who expressed regret.

entities.name: Thurzen Klathe
entities.description: Lord High Priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Sent a mercenary company to answer the plea.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Led the mercenary company that joined the orcs and goblins.

events.summary: An orc-goblin alliance attacks Gurn Keep and General Danhelm is slain.
events.quote: the dwarven leader General Danhelm was slain

events.summary: Sarya takes control and leads the surviving dwarves into an abandoned mine.
events.quote: Sarya, taking control, led the surviving dwarves into a nearby abandoned mine

events.summary: Sarya's plea is forwarded to the Order of the Ebon Hand, the only nation to pledge aid.
events.quote: the only nation that pledged aid was the Order of the Ebon Hand

events.summary: Jursdotter's forces are seen among the orcs and goblins, having joined them.
events.quote: Jursdotter's forces were seen amongst the orcs and goblins

relations.quote: a mercenary company led by Ivra Jursdotter
